offensiveAbilities.name: Lightning Crash
offensiveAbilities.description:
The uthul unleashes a powerful bolt of lightning and a stunning thunderclap. The bolt deals 6d12 Electricity Damage damage to all creatures in a 30ft Line, with a Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save, and every creature in a 20ft Emanation must attempt a Basic DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

The uthul can't use Lightning Crash again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stunned 1.

Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Form
offensiveAbilities.description:
The uthul transforms itself into a swirling vortex of storm and fury 10 feet wide and up to 40 feet tall. It stays in this form for 3 rounds or until it Dismisses the effect. While in this form, the uthul gains resistance 10 to physical damage and can move through other creatures.

Its aura remains active, but it can't make debris Strikes nor use Lightning Crash. Instead, any creature the uthul moves through takes 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage] damage. A creature can take this damage only once per round. A Large or smaller creature must also succeed at a DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save or be picked up and held suspended within the vortex. Suspended creatures move with the uthul. A creature can attempt to escape by spending an action to attempt a DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save (or a Acrobatics check to maneuver in flight if it has a fly Speed). Upon escaping, or when the uthul transforms back into its storm cloud form, a suspended creature is hurled 1d4 x 10 feet in a random direction, then falls unless it can fly or otherwise remain aloft.

After returning to its normal form, the uthul must wait 1 minute before it can use Whirlwind Form again.

Effect: Whirlwind Form
